notes: Prototype test encounter: the party against 4 Klingons. Played on whichever map file in the project's maps/ folder is picked in Load Episode; there is no default map.

Tiles come from the shared catalogue (src/data/adaptation/maps/tiles.json): solid tiles block movement, tiles that block sight block line of fire, and standing next to a cover tile gives cover automatically. Hazard tiles are ordinary floor in this mode.

The party stands on the map's player starts in party order (so the map's player start count is the party size limit). roster: the enemies placed on the map's enemy spawns, in order, as character ids (full characters in src/data/adaptation/characters.json, the same records the exploration actors use); extra spawns stay empty.
The objective text is placeholder content.
autoCombat.playerInjuryMode: the setting AI-controlled player characters use in Auto Combat. Designer spec: 'stun' (Starfleet default); 'deadly' only if set here explicitly.

standardIssueWeapon: designer decision (Oct 2026) for balance. A party member who brings no weapon of their own (only the always-available Unarmed Strike) is issued this one for the fight. Combat-only: the character's file and export are not changed.

encounters.name: Exploration Contact
encounters.notes: Combat started in the exploration world (src/exploration/combatLink.js): no roster or spawns; the fighters are whoever is in the world at that moment, where they stand. Objective text is placeholder content.
